label.en: ● Definition 5.1 — Sampling Distribution Parameters & the Central Limit Theorem
label.ar: ● تعريف 5.1 — الوحدة 5 · توزيعات المعاينة ونظرية النهاية المركزية والمقدرات النقطية

body.en: For independent random samples of size \( n \) (with \( n < 0.10N \)): (1) The sample proportion \( \hat{p} \) has mean \( \mu_{\hat{p}} = p \) and standard deviation \( \sigma_{\hat{p}} = \sqrt{\frac{p(1-p)}{n}} \), approximately normal when \( np \ge 10 \) and \( n(1-p) \ge 10 \); (2) The sample mean \( \bar{x} \) has mean \( \mu_{\bar{x}} = \mu \) and standard deviation \( \sigma_{\bar{x}} = \frac{\sigma}{\sqrt{n}} \), approximately normal when the population is normal or \( n \ge 30 \) by the Central Limit Theorem.
body.ar: For independent random samples of size \( n \) (with \( n < 0.10N \)): (1) The sample proportion \( \hat{p} \) has mean \( \mu_{\hat{p}} = p \) and standard deviation \( \sigma_{\hat{p}} = \sqrt{\frac{p(1-p)}{n}} \), approximately normal when \( np \ge 10 \) and \( n(1-p) \ge 10 \); (2) The sample mean \( \bar{x} \) has mean \( \mu_{\bar{x}} = \mu \) and standard deviation \( \sigma_{\bar{x}} = \frac{\sigma}{\sqrt{n}} \), approximately normal when the population is normal or \( n \ge 30 \) by the Central Limit Theorem.

label.en: ◆ Why It Works — First-Principles Derivation (Unit 5 · Sampling Distributions, Central Limit Theorem & Point Estimators)
label.ar: ◆ البرهان والاشتقاق الرياضي (الوحدة 5 · توزيعات المعاينة ونظرية النهاية المركزية والمقدرات النقطية)

body.en: First-Principles Justification: Completing the square on \( ax^2 + bx + c \) gives \( a\!\left(x + \frac{b}{2a}\right)^2 + \left(c - \frac{b^2}{4a}\right) \), which simultaneously establishes the vertex coordinates, discriminant condition \( \Delta = b^2 - 4ac \), and quadratic root formula.
body.ar: البرهان الجبري: بإكمال المربع للمقدار \(ax^2 + bx + c\) نحصل على صيغة الرأس والمميز \(\Delta = b^2 - 4ac\) بدقة تامة.

body.en:
Problem: Express \( f(x) = x^2 - 12x + 41 \) in completed-square vertex form and find its minimum value.

Solution: Halving \( -12 \) gives \( -6 \), so \( f(x) = (x - 6)^2 - 36 + 41 = (x - 6)^2 + 5 \). Minimum value is \( 5 \) at \( x = 6 \).
body.ar:
المسألة: أوجد صيغة إكمال المربع للدالة \( f(x) = x^2 - 12x + 41 \).

الحل: \( f(x) = (x - 6)^2 + 5 \) والقيمة الصغرى هي \( 5 \) عند \( x = 6 \).

body.en:
Problem: Find the value of \( k \) for which \( y = 2x + k \) is tangent to \( y = x^2 - 12x + 41 \).

Solution: Equating gives \( x^2 - 14x + (41 - k) = 0 \). Setting \( \Delta = (-14)^2 - 4(41 - k) = 0 \) yields \( k = -8 \).
body.ar:
المسألة: أوجد قيمة \( k \) التي تجعل المستقيم \( y = 2x + k \) مماساً للمنحنى \( y = x^2 - 12x + 41 \).

الحل: بوضع المميز \( \Delta = 0 \) نجد \( k = -8 \).

label.en: Worked Example 5.C — Rate of Change & Tangent Slope
label.ar: مثال محلول 5.C — معدل التغير وميل المماس

body.en:
Problem: Find the instantaneous rate of change of \( g(x) = x^3 - 18x^2 + 108x + 5 \) at \( x = 8 \).

Solution: \( g'(x) = 3(x - 6)^2 \), so \( g'(8) = 3(2)^2 = 12 \).
body.ar:
المسألة: أوجد معدل التغير اللحظي للدالة \( g(x) = x^3 - 18x^2 + 108x + 5 \) عند \( x = 8 \).

الحل: \( g'(8) = 3(2)^2 = 12 \).
